coated RC facade
facade plane z=-7.30 m
75 mm OD PVC-U macro pipe
rough dielectric; metallic≈0; smoothness target 0.18

g.text: socket/coupler sleeves; dark grime only under causal water/dust traps
galvanized band → stand-off arm → wall plate → two fastener heads

svg.text: pipe centre 120 mm proud of wall
rear pipe surface ≈82.5 mm clear of wall
roof-line offset returns into wall/scupper collar; no open gap
ground receiver socket: pipe inserts ≈20 mm
lower 0.5 m: splash/damp/grime increase; no arbitrary damage mask
LOD / render policy
LOD0: body + couplers + bands + arms + plates + fasteners + top offset + receiver
LOD1: macro body + major accessory proxies; sub-pixel fasteners may disappear
LOD2: macro body silhouette remains; small wall hardware removed
LOD3: macro body only; no coarse late silhouette replacement
Material response
PVC-U: rough dielectric, F0≈0.04; grazing highlight must arise from Fresnel/lighting
Galvanized hardware: metallic 0.75–1.0, broad rough-metal response
No baked white glints, no painted joint shadows, no fake seam normals at silhouette scale
Cause-based aging
outward PVC: UV chalking / slight desaturation
socket lower lips + wall-side recess: retained grime
metal anchors: localized oxidation residue only at actual ferrous source
ground receiver: splash/damp concentration
Visual Fidelity remains UNSCORED until native 3840×2160 evidence + 100% crops exist.
